facts.raw_span: A 59-year-old Japanese man presented with malaise and chills that began the day before his visit
Medical history included hypertension and hyperlipidemia
he was diagnosed with acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL)
a history of perianal abscess during induction chemotherapy
On day 10 of hospitalization, he experienced a 40.2°C fever
chills, and right upper quadrant abdominal pain when breathing deeply or coughing
Percussion tenderness in the right upper quadrant
Leukocyte count 0.1 × 10⁹/L (50% neutrophils)
Alkaline phosphatase 1065 U/L
Multiple, small, circumscribed, hypoattenuating lesions in the liver and spleen
Blood cultures: Positive for yeast after 30 hours
Molecular identification: D1/D2 26S rDNA and internal transcribed spacer region of rRNA gene analysis performed
